opportunity_theme: Over-Complex Data & Auth Tooling for Indie Devs
name: SoloStack
tagline: Lightweight MongoDB dashboards & auth that just work for indie devs
problem: Solo founders waste days configuring enterprise tools like Metabase and Auth0 for simple MongoDB visualization and user auth, while lightweight alternatives lack trust and reliability.
solution: SoloStack provides a zero-config MongoDB dashboard and authentication layer that deploys in minutes. It combines visual query building, auto-generated admin panels, and battle-tested auth (email/password, OAuth, magic links) — all without the bloat of enterprise platforms.
features: Auto-generated MongoDB admin UI with CRUD, filters, and relation browsing
Visual query builder → charts/dashboards (no MQL/SQL needed)
Auth: email/password, magic links, Google/GitHub OAuth, JWT tokens
React/React Native SDK + REST API for custom frontends
Role-based access control (admin, editor, viewer) out of the box
One-click deploy to Railway/Render/Fly.io with managed MongoDB
CLI for local dev & schema migrations
Self-hosted or cloud with solo-dev friendly pricing
mvp_scope: Ship a self-hosted Docker image that connects to any MongoDB URI, auto-generates an admin panel with CRUD + charts, and issues JWTs via email/password + Google OAuth. Skip multi-tenancy, embeddable dashboards, and CLI in v1.
tech_stack: Next.js 14 (App Router, API routes, server actions)
NextAuth.js v5 (auth providers, JWT sessions, adapters)

competitors.name: Metabase
competitors.gap: Java-based, heavy resource usage, overkill for simple MongoDB; no built-in auth

competitors.name: Auth0
competitors.gap: Complex setup, pricing spikes at scale, docs assume enterprise architecture

competitors.name: Firebase
competitors.gap: Vendor lock-in, Firestore ≠ MongoDB, trust issues from Google sunset history

competitors.name: AdminBro
competitors.gap: Requires custom code per resource, not zero-config, auth is DIY

competitors.name: PocketBase
competitors.gap: SQLite-only, not MongoDB; auth mature but data layer wrong for this pain

landing_copy.headline: Stop Wrestling Metabase. Start Shipping.
landing_copy.subheadline: SoloStack gives you a production-ready MongoDB admin panel + auth in 5 minutes. Zero config. Self-hosted. Built for indie devs.
bullets: Auto-admin UI from your MongoDB collections
Visual dashboards — no query language needed
Auth with email, magic links, OAuth in one SDK
Deploy to Railway/Fly.io with one click
Self-hosted — your data, your server, your rules

whatsapp_bot.flow: Dev connects MongoDB URI → bot provisions SoloStack instance → sends dashboard URL + auth credentials → dev manages users/collections via chat commands
whatsapp_bot.pricing: Free self-hosted; $19/mo managed cloud (includes hosting, backups, SSL)

pricing_model: Free self-hosted (MIT); $19/mo managed cloud with auto-backups, SSL, custom domain; $49/mo team (SSO, audit logs, priority support)
